name: Hiyoku wa Azami no Kanata e ~Kuon no Sou~
original_name: 比翼は愛薊の彼方へ ～久遠の想～
source:
This is a sequel of Hiyoku wa Azami no Kanata e -Miryou no In-. Shoukou and Kakkai regain power after a while to get back the throne. But, Shoukou needs to defeat the current king Kaikou, his younger brother, to get it back. One day, Sai, a neighboring country, begins to invade their country....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090406202903/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_52/products_id/1007670]Erogeshop[/url]]
translation:
本作是《比翼は愛薊の彼方へ～未了の因～》的续作。一段时间后，尚香与贾诩重整势力，准备夺回王位。但尚香必须先击败现任国王——自己的弟弟海光。一天，邻国蔡开始入侵他们的国家…
